scope: 46 canonical runtime scenes: fifteen admitted public scenes,28 core personal scenes and three deferred-minigame mixed personal scenes. Read-only shipped artifacts; no game,UI,server,listener,attach,connection or live state.

key_contract.source: provenance only; never disambiguates duplicate roots
key_contract.root: exact topmost Transform GameObject name, stripping only an exact trailing (Clone)
key_contract.root_uniqueness: one active top root with that normalized name across all geometry,logic and event sources; missing/duplicate runtime anchor rejects whole map
key_contract.path: Transform.m_Children sibling indices, excluding root; inactive siblings still occupy indices
key_contract.slot: full GameObject.m_Component index, including Transform/native components
key_contract.enabled: disabled MonoBehaviours on active GameObjects remain in FindObjectsOfType; inactive hierarchies excluded
key_contract.numeric_runtime_ids: not inferred; exact-set native registration supplies IDs after trusted semantic comparison
key_contract.null_scripts: Only null m_Script,base-only32bytes,script_type_index=-1 and zero script/type hashes are missing-script placeholders. Their exclusion from typed enumeration is source-based, with exact-set runtime check required.
key_contract.separate_protocol: entry consumes registry enumeration but override sends another opcode; 94 relay denied
key_contract.original_server_policy: unavailable; ordinary relay and exact source-bound admission are explicit preservation policy

reviewed_subtypes.occupable_override_review: BenchCinema,Jacuzzi,Toilet call NebulaSeat.Interact and NebulaOccupable.LeaveInteract plus local UI/events; SeatSelection opens local animation menu and Leave calls NebulaOccupable. AnimationTrigger/Bench inherit NebulaOccupable.Interact; RemoteInteract is shared empty body35a740. No additional occupable wire extensions.
reviewed_subtypes.generic_override_review: All ordinary callbacks reviewed in tcp-world-interactions.json. Extension arity comes from exact serialized GenericInteractable.data array. DayNightTrigger.Interact44f580 emits30 and remains present but denied94.
